title: Choose Raak's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Care Diagram. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: مخطط الرعاية · The Care Diagram
options.lineage: metropolitan transit diagrams and hospital wayfinding — Riyadh Metro, Dubai Metro, clinic signage
options.thesis: The agency's day as a transit diagram: caregivers are route lines, visits are stations, assignments are traced routes. Travel buffers, gaps, and visit states read the way a city's movement reads — the product's core mechanism (conflict-free scheduling across a city of homes) becomes the interface itself.
materials: paper-white diagram ground (light-first translation of enamel signage)
options.viewport: The dashboard opens on the day's corridor: a horizontal day-timeline where each caregiver is a quiet colored route, visits are station nodes with state ticks (planned hollow, scheduled filled, in-progress pulsing ring, completed struck), travel buffers visible as connecting segments; unassigned visits wait in a service-alerts rail on the side. Assignment is literally tracing a route; a conflict is two lines claiming one segment — visible before it happens.
options.risk: Systematic precision can read cold. The Attio-grade warmth must come from the paper-white ground, generous air between routes, tabular-numeral calm, and human annotation marks — without them it's a network-monitor dashboard, not care.

raised.raise: Full diagram grammar folded in: routes bend only at 45°/90°, interchanges (shared patients, back-to-back visits) bloom as circles, corridor focus keeps transfer context visible while a caregiver's day is examined.
Tabular numerals at true data density are the only ornament — timestamps, durations and counts carry the visual interest; no decoration beside the data.
The day's capacity is a visible physical quantity — a coordinator sees when a caregiver's side of the tape is full before accepting another visit.
Selection and completion feel annotated by a person — a circled row, a struck-through completed visit — states with a hand-kept soul.
One live thing carries the color weight at a time — the visit being resolved now; the rest of the surface stays quiet.
Active states flood a soft tinted field instead of adding another outline — selection is a filled zone, not a border.

options.label: دفتر العمليات · The Operations Ledger
options.lineage: Arabic business ledgers (دفتر السجلات) — right-bound ruled registers, stamped headers, tabular columns
options.thesis: The workspace as the agency's living register: every table a ruled register page, every state a stamp or marginal mark. Records carry the authority of the ledger books Arabic offices have trusted for a century — warm, exact, human-kept.
materials: ruled columns with fine inked lines
marginal annotations in the accent ink
options.viewport: The dashboard opens as a spread of the day's register: today's visits ruled across the page in tabular numerals, states as small stamps (مؤكدة، قيد التنفيذ، منجزة), the margin holding what needs a human — unassigned flags and late notes in lavender annotation ink, like a supervisor's pen.
options.risk: The direction closest to the quiet-table SaaS this category already ships — Attio/Notion adjacent, exactly the bar you chose. Familiar and effective is a legitimate destination; but without deep commitment to paper tone, ruling rhythm and mark-making, it reads as generic calm admin.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: The network as an enamel mural: colored lines on midnight ground, interchanges blooming at crossings.
options.viewport: The whole city of care as one legible diagram of movement.
options.case: Fused so completely with the assigned direction that it merged into the lead card as its grammar — 45/90° bends, interchange circles, corridor focus, service states (open, delayed, suspended → planned, late, cancelled). Locked here only as the proof of fusion; choosing the lead card is choosing this world, translated to Raak's locked light-first palette.
options.risk: Its midnight enamel ground contradicts the locked light-first palette — the lead card is its faithful light translation.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.case: Fuses poorly: giant cropped headlines and tile-only navigation cannot carry 14px dense bilingual tables all day.
options.kept: Type-led states — selection floods a tinted field instead of adding outlines.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.case: Fuses poorly for an operate surface: hard physical halves and handwriting fight mutable queues and precise tabular states.
options.kept: Sides with visible capacity — a caregiver's day shows when it is full.

options.label: Convention Circle Catalog
options.case: Holds browse, loses operate: a stamp-thumbnail grid is for discovering among thousands, not running a day of twenty caregivers; newsprint gray fights crisp locked tables.
options.kept: Human mark-making on state — circled selection, struck-through completion.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.case: Fuses against product law: labels encoded as color strips alone violate the locked 'label plus tint, never hue alone' status rule; matte black fights light-first.
options.kept: One live thing in full color at a time — the rest of the surface quiet.

options.label: Data-Sublime Lattice
options.case: Hostile to an all-day accessibility-gated workspace: strobing inversion and data-sublime coldness are wrong for coordinators and reduced-motion rules; audience identification near zero.
options.kept: Data density as the only ornament — tabular numerals carry the visual interest.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The generic admin SaaS — sidebar, KPI cards, data table — executed impeccably. This is the Linear-adjacent door, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement every ops tool ships, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
